Protocol: the as-built CancelToken/CancelState/check_cancel request-epoch protocol (ADR-cancel-request-epoch) - one atomic token word (pending bit + monotonic request epoch), request()/rearm() advance the epoch in one CAS, clear() drops pending, reset_acknowledgement() is the explicit per-consumer re-arm (acked := 0), check_cancel delivers on ONE snapshot iff unblocked AND pending AND acked#epoch (single-shot per request BETWEEN the two explicit re-arm authorities: token rearm() and per-consumer reset_acknowledgement(); a redelivery under either authority is legal). C++-first correction: this is a REQUEST-epoch protocol, NOT a task-incarnation protocol - the token is long-lived and shareable (Group shares one token across tasks), reuse is clear()+new request() plus per-consumer acknowledgement across request generations; the boundary is 1 token, 2 consumers {A,B}, request generations 0..3. Closes MODEL-007(c) from audit #162 / umbrella #171 (child #180) - the last MODEL-007 residual. Safety-only, SC protocol abstraction (one atomic uint64; per-consumer CancelState is plain consumer-owned; no C++ weak-memory claim). Seven laws (single-shot between explicit re-arms - dupDelivered is a delivery with acked[c]=epoch, i.e. without re-arm authority; no delivery while idle; protection blocks delivery not request; clear removes intent; stale ack cannot starve delivery; historical provenance delivered-epoch-was-requested; ack-is-a-real-epoch). Five one-rule cfg-flip negatives with named CEXs (pre-fix sticky-bool ack / clear keeps pending / dropped single-shot gate / dropped pending gate / dropped protection gate) plus 5 per-defect specificity cfgs (NegStickyAck excludes its entailed co-victim InvNoStaleAckStarvesDelivery). 9 reachability witnesses (PR #181 review-fix rounds: NoReachNewRequestDelivered pinned on the fresh post-clear request's EXACT epoch lastClearedEpoch + 1 (round-3 tightening: clear leaves the epoch unchanged and only request() from idle advances the epoch after a clear, so the immediate successor epoch is the fresh request; a clear->request->rearm->deliver-later-epoch chain cannot impersonate it); protection witness per-consumer blockedCheckedEpochs[c]; rearm witness requires the SAME consumer delivered the re-armed epoch (RearmedFromEpoch derived from rearmEpoch); new NoReachResetRedelivers witness for the explicit per-consumer re-arm; all impersonation continuations proven excluded by INIT probes). Discarded hypotheses: HC2 epoch-advanced-too-late (no observable window - the CAS is the linearization point) and HC4 (no task terminal boundary in the token protocol). Adversarial probes A-I documented. C++ bridges: tests/cancel_token_test.cpp (request->deliver, single-shot, rearm re-delivery, protection, clear+request fresh, shared-token, idempotent request; cancel_shared_token_two_consumers_deliver_and_rearm executes reset_acknowledgement()); the rearm and clear+request cases fail on the pre-fix implementation (ADR section 4 RED/GREEN) - no production seam needed.

Protocol: rwlock writer-fair FIFO reconcile (unlock/cancel/expire head-prefix grant) plus timed admission (*_lock_until). Negative models: ReaderBypass (admission barging), NoReconcile (release drops grant-from-head, stranding a grantable head), WriterRevoke (MODEL-002 control: writer reconcile drops the activeReaders = 0 guard, revoking a live reader), and DeadlinePrecedence (MODEL-003 sensitivity control: ONLY the due=TRUE successor of ReadUntilAdmit/WriteUntilAdmit resolves Expired and commits NO ownership — due=FALSE is exactly the positive behavior; a due deadline beats the admissible resource while the evidence latches stay TRUE, violating InvResourceFirstDeadline, and the sibling .specificity.cfg proves the SAME mutant passes the remaining 12 positive invariants, so the negative is exact) — 5 negative gates = 4 violation gates + 1 specificity pass gate across 4 negative models; the latter two GENERATED from the positive model by scripts/formal/gen-rwlock-neg-writer-revoke.py and gen-rwlock-neg-deadline-precedence.py, whose --check freshness modes run inside verify-async-rwlock.sh BEFORE TLC (a stale committed negative fails the gate; the IF-form ghost is required because an unparenthesized x' = y \/ c parses as (x' = y) \/ c under TLA+ precedence — a language pitfall, not a TLC limitation). Reachability witnesses (MODEL-001 closure, non-vacuity): cancel/expire reader-prefix merge, cancel/expire writer-refused head stays blocked, and the writer-blocked contrast — each NoReach* is violated, proving the reconcile branches fire in the as-built model — plus the two MODEL-003 timed-admission halves (resource beats an already-due deadline; inline admission-expire when not admissible). Positive gate checks 13 invariants including ReaderRevocationFree (RW10) and InvResourceFirstDeadline (RW11, MODEL-003 closure at parity with E12Semaphore P7 / E12AsyncMutex M7).

coverage_gaps.why_no_model_yet: The single-slot load-bearing core is now modeled (suite request-arena, 2026-08-18 formal audit; smallest-model rule of AGENTS.md section 17). The residual gap is deliberately open: ready-ring FIFO ORDER across >=2 simultaneous backend_ready slots multiplies the state space for a property whose load-bearing content (per-slot order preservation between terminal winner and reap publication) is already covered by the single-slot model plus executable evidence. Modeling it requires a capacity-2 suite variant; do not read the current suite as multi-slot coverage.
